name: @pipeworx/mcp-ntsb-investigations

tools.name: ntsb_search_investigations
tools.description: NTSB aviation accident/incident investigations — plane crashes — by aircraft registration (tail) number or by make/model, optionally filtered by `state`, `year`, or `injury_level` (fatal, serious, minor, none). Returns NTSB number, event date, location, injury level, phase/occurrence, probable cause, findings, and the NTSB docket link for each match. Registration numbers (N-numbers) are reused over time by different aircraft; pass `year` to narrow a registration match to one incarnation when more than one comes back. A broad make with no `model` or `year` may be asked to narrow — this reads a small sharded dataset, never a full scan. For a date-range or cross-make query with no make/registration (e.g. "fatal accidents in Alaska in 2025"), use `ntsb_accidents_by_period` instead. Sourced from the NTSB's own eADMS aviation accident database (data.ntsb.gov/avdata).

registration.description: Aircraft registration / tail number, e.g. "N512SP" (dashes/spacing ignored).

year.description: Limit to events in this calendar year. Required for a common make (e.g. Cessna, Piper) unless `model` is also given.

state.description: US state postal abbreviation of the event location, e.g. "CA".

injury_level.description: Highest injury level reported for the event: fatal, serious, minor, or none.

tools.name: ntsb_accidents_by_period
tools.description: NTSB aviation accidents and incidents — plane crashes — in a date range, across every aircraft make, grouped by US state with counts. Answers questions like "fatal aviation accidents in Alaska in 2025", "plane crashes by state in May 2024", or "how many fatal crashes in California last year" in one call. Filter by `injury_level` (fatal, serious, minor, none) and/or `state`; `from`/`to` accept "YYYY", "YYYY-MM", or "YYYY-MM-DD" and are both inclusive (`to` defaults to the end of `from`'s own year/month). Returns per-state counts (`by_state`) for every match plus up to 200 individual records — NTSB number, event date, location, injury level, phase, probable cause, docket link. Sourced from the NTSB's own eADMS aviation accident database (data.ntsb.gov/avdata); a range spanning more than 8 calendar years is refused — narrow it.

from.description: Start of the date range, inclusive. "YYYY", "YYYY-MM", or "YYYY-MM-DD", e.g. "2024-05" or "2025-01-01".

to.description: End of the date range, inclusive, same formats as `from`. Omit to default to the end of `from`'s own year/month.

state.description: US state postal abbreviation of the event location, e.g. "AK".

injury_level.description: Highest injury level reported for the event: fatal, serious, minor, or none.

limit.description: Max individual records to return (default 50, max 200). `by_state` counts cover every match regardless of this cap.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-ntsb-investigations forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the ntsb-investigations pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
